title: Annihilator of a finite module under flat base change
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a flat map of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] and let $M$ be a finitely generated $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Then the annihilator of the base-changed module is the extended annihilator: $\operatorname{Ann}_S(M\otimes_R S)=\operatorname{Ann}_R(M)S$, where $\operatorname{Ann}_R(M)=\{r\in R:rm=0\text{ for every }m\in M\}$ and $\operatorname{Ann}_R(M)S$ is the ideal generated by the image of $\operatorname{Ann}_R(M)$ in $S$.
